title: The phone's two bootloader copies differ
body: The installer measured the phone's second bootloader copy: slot A's is fake-1.0, slot B's is fake-0.9. Omarchy Mobile starts from slot B, so both have to be the same version, and they are not.
Slot A is the active slot again, and the phone runs its bootloader.
With different versions the phone may not start from slot B. Google's own tools put the same version on both: the install guide says how.
footer: The installer asked the phone what it is and measured its second bootloader copy: that changed the bootloader's slot flags, and slot A was made the active slot again and seen to run. It has written nothing else to the phone.
Starting the installer again as things are will stop here again.
